sources.title: Silent Tools turning application guide
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 精密磨削加工
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付受力圖、防滑比值與變形風險比較。；教學靜態比值至少 1.5，乾淨假設通過、低摩擦假設失敗；實機仍需合格夾持驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver free-body diagram, slip ratio and deformation-risk comparison.; A teaching ratio of at least 1.5 accepts the clean assumption and rejects low friction; real clamping needs qualified validation.
related.difference: 以比能指標辨識磨削效率下降，避免只用表面外觀放行。
related.differenceEn: Use specific energy to detect deteriorating grinding efficiency rather than accepting appearance alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 理想可抵抗力矩 M=μNtotal r；接觸力相加但不可重複計入每爪。；教學 μ=0.20、Ntotal=300 N、r=0.020 m；外加力矩 0.60 N·m。；M=0.20×300×0.020=1.20 N·m，靜態比值為 2。
比能 u=Pnet/Qv，W 除 mm³/s 得 J/mm³。；教學淨功率 100 W、體積去除率 5 mm³/s。；u=100/5=20 J/mm³。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ideal resisting torque M=μNtotal r; sum contact forces without counting each jaw twice.; Teaching μ=0.20, Ntotal=300 N, r=0.020 m and external torque 0.60 N·m.; M=0.20×300×0.020=1.20 N·m, a static ratio of two.
Specific energy u=Pnet/Qv; W divided by mm³/s gives J/mm³.; Teaching net power 100 W and volumetric removal 5 mm³/s.; u=100/5=20 J/mm³.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 定向能量沉積修復
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付受力圖、防滑比值與變形風險比較。；教學靜態比值至少 1.5，乾淨假設通過、低摩擦假設失敗；實機仍需合格夾持驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver free-body diagram, slip ratio and deformation-risk comparison.; A teaching ratio of at least 1.5 accepts the clean assumption and rejects low friction; real clamping needs qualified validation.
related.difference: 建立掃描缺損、補料體積與精加工餘量的一致基準，分清成形外觀與冶金結合證據。
related.differenceEn: Reconcile scan loss, deposited volume and machining allowance without confusing shape recovery with metallurgical bonding.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 理想可抵抗力矩 M=μNtotal r；接觸力相加但不可重複計入每爪。；教學 μ=0.20、Ntotal=300 N、r=0.020 m；外加力矩 0.60 N·m。；M=0.20×300×0.020=1.20 N·m，靜態比值為 2。
近似矩形槽以 V=Lwh 計體積；捕獲率只連接送粉質量與沉積質量，不代表熔合品質。 教學槽長 40 mm、寬 6 mm、缺損深 1.2 mm，另留 0.3 mm 加工量；密度 8.0 g/cm³，捕獲率 0.60。 V=40×6×1.5=360 mm³=0.360 cm³；沉積質量 2.88 g，估計供粉 2.88/0.60=4.80 g。忽略側壁坡度與稀釋。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ideal resisting torque M=μNtotal r; sum contact forces without counting each jaw twice.; Teaching μ=0.20, Ntotal=300 N, r=0.020 m and external torque 0.60 N·m.; M=0.20×300×0.020=1.20 N·m, a static ratio of two.

For a rectangular groove V=Lwh; capture efficiency connects supplied and deposited mass, not bond quality. Teaching groove: 40×6 mm, loss depth 1.2 mm, allowance 0.3 mm; density 8.0 g/cm³ and capture fraction 0.60. V=40×6×1.5=360 mm³=0.360 cm³; deposit mass 2.88 g and feed estimate 2.88/0.60=4.80 g. Side slopes and dilution are omitted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
